description: Get how to reach Codemate: office addresses with map links, named people with their role, email, phone, LinkedIn and photo, plus the general sales email and phone numbers. Filter by role or office. Use this when asked how to contact Codemate, who to speak to about something, or where its offices are.

lang.description: Which language edition of the site to answer from. Defaults to English.

role.description: Role filter, e.g. "sales", "CEO", "recruit". Matches part of the job title.
